scope: Independent bounded review of the ARCv2 EM callee packet. This validates pinned extraction and instruction-grounded control-flow interpretation at the available decoder level; it does not close dependencies, global ownership, or runtime mapping beyond the pinned conditional coordinate record.
checks: Ran the candidate verifier successfully: 206 selected bytes, 67 contiguous decoded instructions, all 27 inputs and 28 output pins, exact package/image mapping, direct caller edge, and bounded extent checks passed.
Verified the frozen output manifest: all 28 files have the stated sizes and SHA-256 hashes.

Compared whole-image and isolated-slice objdump listings; the selected 206-byte sequences match instruction-for-instruction. The caller's BL.D at 0x0030EDE8 targets 0x0030EF44 and its delay slot sets r3=1 as described.

Manually traced the delayed call at 0x0030EF5A (r0=r15 delay slot), branch at 0x0030EF84 (r13=0 delay slot), terminator branch at 0x0030EFEA (r0=r15+4 delay slot), signed-count dispatch at 0x0030EFF4, indirect call at 0x0030EFFE (r2=r12 delay slot), and helper call at 0x0030F00A (r0=r12 delay slot). The described control flow and argument setup agree with the listing.

The skipped early branch compares a register just loaded with literal 0x00335BC8 against zero; it is statically false for these bytes. The zero/nonzero gate helper result and zero terminator paths preserve the stated return behavior, conditional on called targets returning.
The conditional record-3 mapping and direct call are backed by the pinned package extraction and 310 caller record. The packet does not promote the symbol seed to proof of semantic identity.
limitations: No independent ARCv2 EM decoder was available; the two listings are generated by the same pinned GNU ARC toolchain, so they corroborate extraction/offsets but are not independent ISA implementations.

Helpers 0x00333C24 and 0x0033301C, external 0x001030DC, indirect R14 targets, ABI effects and nonreturn behavior remain unresolved. No target-class or hardware meaning is inferred from address comparisons.
Global alternate-entry ownership was not surveyed, and the conditional loaded mapping is not a hardware execution observation. No dynamic replay or canonical admission is claimed.
